name: itmo-study-knowledge-base
description: Read-only website projection of the existing university notes

scripts.docs:prepare: npm run kb:generate && npm run mindmap:export && node tools/build-site.mjs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:prepare && vitepress dev site --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:prepare && vitepress build site
